FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of FA AND CAO, NORTH EASTERN RAILWAY, GORAKHPUR A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The bidder shall deploy the adequate no. of manpower to achieve the satisfactory service and follow the other terms and condition. In case of service found to be unsatisfactory, the contract shall be cancelled wit h forfeiture of submitted Performance security. 2. It is the sole responsibility of bidders to access requirement of service to be provided under this bid befo re the submission of their offer. In case of bidder withdraw its offer, action of suspension of bidder GeM acc ount shall be initiated. 3. No additional documents/Information, which are not part of original offer shall be accepted after the bid opening. The offer shall only be evaluated on the basis of details/documents submitted in the original offer . 4. The bidders are required to properly examine and see the attached PDF document containing scope of work, location and special terms and conditions etc. before submission of its bids. 5.All other terms & conditions and statutory requirement shall be governed as per GeM (SLA) for this categ ory. 6. For other special terms & conditions please refer attached scope of work. 7. The tenderer(s)/Firm are to upload the filled and notarized affidavit on a stamp paper as per format encl osed scope of work Annexure-I along with their bid.The bid shall be summarily rejected if the bidder fails to submit this undertaking along with the bid. 8.T2 -Liquidity: - The bidder should have access to or has available liquid assests, lines of credit and other f inancial means to meet cash flow that is valued at 5 % of the estimated bid value net of applicant's commi tments for other contracts. The audited balance sheet and/or banking reference certified by chartered acc ountant with his stamp, signature and membership number shall be submitted by the bidder along with bi d as per sample format Annexure III. 9.Service provider will be responsible for salary/wages and all other statutory benefits e.g. EPF, ESIC etc to his staff . 10. Bidder should submit the site visit certificate as per format enclosed scope of work Annexure-II, which should be duly signed by Chief Health Inspector, N.E. Railway, New Model Colony otherwise bidder offer wi ll be summarily rejected. 11. The Bidder must be uploaded the following documents along with the bid. Otherwise offer will be sum marily rejected. i. GST Registration Certificate of the firm, ii. EPF Registration Certificate of the firm, iii. ESI C Registration Certificate of the firm, iv. PAN CARD copy of the firm, v. Aadhar Card copy of the firm, vi. La bour Registration Certificate of the firm. 12. The service provider must be registered on the shram suvidha portal of the Ministry of Labour and Emp loyment, Government of India. The bidder shall submit a valid Labour Identification Number (LIN) certificat e issued by the portal along with the technical bid. 13. Each page of the copy of documents/ certificates in support of credentials , submitted by the bidder, s hall be self -attested by the bidder or authorized representative of the bidding firm. Self-attestation sh all i nclude signatures, stamp and date (on each page). Only those, documents will be considered for evaluatin

g bid, which are duly self- attested as above. 14. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates /documents sought in t he Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. No documents will be accepted after opening of bid. .
